smt-2020-general-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Trina has decided to use a ternary counting system (base $3$). If she read the expression of $2020$ in ternary as a date, how many days from today would it be? (Today is February 22, 2020.)
smt-2020-general-tiebreaker-01.reviewNote: Depends on the contest date (February 22, 2020) and on reading 2202211 as 2/20/2211. The official key says 69760 because it counts 47 leap days; 2200 is not a leap year, so the correct count is 69759.

smt-2020-general-tiebreaker-02.prompt: A pen is tethered to the corner of a square box of side length $2$ cm by a string of length $4$ cm. What is the area of the largest shape that can be drawn with the pen without breaking the string and without the string going through the box? (Do not count the area of the box.)
